title: Designer/Draftsperson
abstract: Opportunity for an experienced Senior Designer to expand their creative flair.
bullets: Have a real flair for design and want to showcase your ability
content_text:
Your next employer:
A design-led business with a passion for creating spaces that are as functional as they are beautiful. From bespoke residential projects to commercial fit-outs and new builds, their work spans a wide range of scales and typologies, and they're proud of every one of them. An inclusive and tight-knit team that takes collaboration seriously, brings genuine care to every project, and believes great design makes a real difference to people's lives.
They're growing, and are looking for an experienced Designer/Draftsperson to grow with them.
The Role:
This is a hands-on design/drafting role with real ownership. You'll work across both residential and commercial projects, from early concept through to documentation and contributing meaningfully at every stage. You'll be trusted to lead design on your own projects, collaborate with team members, and bring fresh thinking to how they work. The role would be split 80% Design and 20% Drafting). 
Day to day, you'll be:
- Meeting with clients to understand requirements
- Design elevations, floor plans, concepts and layouts
- Ensure designs comply with the NCC, R-codes and local planning requirements
- Presenting design options to clients
- Collaborating with other designers/draftspersons and contributing to a positive culture
About You:
You're a creative and technically capable designer who cares about the quality of your work. You have strong opinions about design but know how to listen. You're organised enough to manage multiple projects at once, and collaborative enough to make everyone around you better.
You'll bring:
- 5+ years of design experience either in an architectural practice or residential builder
- Strong design skills across either residential and commercial typologies
- Proficiency in ArchiCAD and 4D Library
- Solid understanding of the NCC and R-codes, planning frameworks, and construction documentation
- Excellent communication skills: written, verbal, and visual
- A proactive attitude and the ability to manage your own workload
Why Join This Business?
- Up to $130,000 + Super
- Work on a genuinely varied project portfolio, no two briefs are the same
- A culture that's collaborative, supportive, and low on ego
- Flexible working arrangements
- A multitude of individual and team benefits
- Clear pathway for growth and professional development
To learn more about the business and the role, please call Ian on 0491 624 155 / ian@bondandco.com.au
Want to see how your current salary compares to the rest of the market? Head over to www.bondandco.com.au to download our latest residential construction salary guide.
